svg.title: Composite: a bundle priced by asking each part for its price
svg.desc: Desk setup, 10 percent off, contains Monitor Rs 12,000, Keyboard kit and Lamp Rs 1,500. Keyboard kit, no discount, contains Keyboard Rs 2,500 and Mouse Rs 1,000, so it costs Rs 3,500. Desk setup sums 12,000 + 3,500 + 1,500 = 17,000 and takes 10 percent off: Rs 15,300. Blue boxes are bundles, green boxes are items.
svg.text: pricePaise() on the root asks every part the same question
